checks.name: Tactical board, profiles and six orientation arrows load without covering cells
Final facing is previewed and can be cancelled without closing the turn or spending RNG
Confirmed facing persists while other units act and the next activation receives focus
Area, per-target accuracy, positional side and collateral preview match pure rules
Confirmed area affects each unit once, spends PT once and paints legal ember tiles
A real route crosses allied sprites and ends on a free square at its exact terrain cost
Flying movement crosses the pond using its own costs while occupancy remains legal
Grid, cancellation and menu support keyboard focus
Full battle reaches victory and clears defeated units without stalled rounds
Same seed and commands replay positions, orientations, fields, HP, PT and status exactly
Passive turns reach defeat with orientation and terrain effects resolving normally
Alternative composition previews and resolves a real push without occupied destinations
Long area previews and final-facing controls fit desktop, short and mobile windows
Normal play has no JavaScript errors or remote asset requests
Animated movement locks orders and resting animations support pause/resume
Slow loading gives progress and keeps commands disabled
Invalid/empty catalogue exposes a retry and recovers combat
A missing sprite becomes a movable marker; reload recovers it without JS errors
